units.source_text: 大友宗助家里，只有老伴一人帮忙缫腰带丝。

en.t: In Otomo Sosuke's household, only his elderly wife helped reel the silk thread for obi sashes.

units.source_text: 长年累月闷头坐着干活，看上去她要比实际年龄苍老得多，人也变得沉默寡言。

en.t: After years and years of sitting silently at her work, she looked much older than she really was, and had grown taciturn as well.
